target_meaning: Recorded gross residential land-and-building transaction consideration per reported registered transferred building ping in the confirmed no-parking subset; not individual-property fair market value.
population: Disclosed existing-sale records declaring residential use, a supported apartment type, at least one land parcel and exactly one building; complete parsed detail joins; no reported note; validated floors; Taipei/New Taipei only in this evidence build.
rights_policy: Complete dwelling rights remain unverified. Fractional transferred portions may be part of an observed transfer. Never label them full dwelling sales or change Target A gates.
unit_policy: Exactly one reported building is a population condition, not proof of a single registered dwelling. Multiple detail portions retain unresolved object roles and registered-unit count labels.
parking_policy: Require existing confirmed-absence classifier plus complete unique joins, no parking detail and no parking words in notes/building uses. Blank parking numerics never mean zero. No adjusted mixed-parking labels in v1.
area_field: 建物移轉總面積平方公尺
area_meaning: Reported registered transferred building area, potentially private/common/ancillary portions; not interior or usable area; no whole-rights assertion.

area_contract.field: 建物移轉總面積平方公尺

area_detail_reconciliation: All building detail areas positive; sum agrees within max(0.01 m², 0.001 * main area); no duplicated detail payloads.
price_normalization: Decimal precision 28: area_ping = reported_m2 * 0.3025; target = total_NTD / area_ping; optional natural logarithm. Mandatory official NTD/m² reconciliation within max(1, 0.001 * derived NTD/m²).
scope_limit_bias: Inherited bounded research support excludes extreme areas/prices. Price-based selection is explicit estimand truncation; cannot be used to screen predictions by their unknown outcome or claim general-market performance.
geography: Source member/embedded manifest proves county; existing pinned admin registry validates district; no district-only county repair or inferred historical names.
source_lineage: Exact expected archive hash, package CRC/limits, embedded manifest and schema/member hashes, dataset, release, physical record number, raw payload and detail hashes. Raw identities stay private.
revision_policy: Candidate IDs are provisional. Full-ledger existing as-of selector must prove stable namespace, versions, predecessor/cancellation states before PIT admission. Missing or conflicting evidence blocks. Selection precedes target eligibility.
historical_availability: Exact-byte authenticated publication or conservative trustworthy observation bound; date-only advances to next Taipei midnight. Present downloads and release labels do not establish past publication.
prediction_context: Conditional transaction-price research using declared characteristics assumed supplied independently at prediction time. Evaluation calendar uses transaction day only as a retrospective scenario; prospective scoring must use the known planned scoring date and prove input availability.
chronology: Existing maturity contract: >=21 contiguous mature months, >=20 rows/month and >=20 district/type rows/block; train then three-month validation/calibration/test; complete coverage evidence and per-freeze full-ledger membership/version equality; calibration never fit/selected on.

baseline_contracts.global_median: Median target from approved frozen TRAIN families/versions strictly public and effective before min(prediction, fit cutoff).
baseline_contracts.district_building_type_median: Same allowed history restricted to subject district/type; fall back only to the same permitted global history. No evaluation-block fitting.
baseline_contracts.historical_comparable_estimator: Same allowed history and verified B target; predefined district/type, area and floor distances. Any neighbor count/window/distance tuning uses TRAIN/VALIDATION only. Exclude subject family and unknown changed-ID links.

baseline_readiness_requires: Approved nonempty as-of cohort, frozen family/version membership, historical input support and viable folds. Contract preparation is not empirical evaluation.
selection_bias: Official disclosure screening, transaction-only population, no-parking/blank-note/exact-use/floor support, partial rights and common portions, two isolated quarters, and target truncation. No population or nationwide generalization.
user_facing_scope: No ML outputs authorized. Future approved research can describe conditional observed transaction price only; individual-property valuation/product claims require explicit approval.
